paras: Emoia parkeri, also known commonly as Parker's emo skink and the Viti copper-headed skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Fiji.
The specific name, parkeri, is in honor of English zoologist Hampton Wildman Parker.
In Fiji, Emoia parkeri has been found on the following islands: Kadavu, Ovalau, Taveuni, and Viti Levu.
The preferred natural habitat of Emoia parkeri is forest, at elevations from sea level to 500 m (1,600 ft).
